key: must:I46c:Three scenes in order, ~3s each: Earth, Jupiter, Saturn
symptom: Three scenes in order, ~3s each: Earth, Jupiter, Saturn

whys.why: Why was 'three scenes in order: Earth, Jupiter, Saturn' not met?
whys.because: Neither graded output showed a real Saturn scene. In the old chat the last third is still Jupiter, now with rings added. In the new chat the grader saw only the Earth and Jupiter clips.
whys.evidence: s5.old.happy.I46c/grade.json: 'no true Saturn scene; frame at 8.6s still shows Jupiter with rings. Transitions are blended', plus the fault 'A ringed Jupiter appears at the end, with a second ringed planet'. s5.new.dumper.I46c/grade.json: 'Only Earth and Jupiter clips are available. No Saturn scene was supplied'.

whys.why: Why did the old chat end on a ringed Jupiter instead of Saturn?
whys.because: The assistant asked for all three scenes in ONE 9-second create_video_from_text call on ltx-2.5. One prompt held 'three equal 3-second scenes with hard cuts', Scene 1 (0-3s), Scene 2 (3-6s) and Scene 3 (6-9s). The model made one continuous shot. It blended Jupiter into the Saturn part instead of cutting to a new scene.
whys.evidence: s5.old.happy.I46c/calls.jsonl line 2: a single create_video_from_text call (end_seconds 9, model ltx-2.5, prompt with 'Scene 1 (0-3s)… Scene 2 (3-6s)… Scene 3 (6-9s)'). There is no other generation call.

whys.why: Why did the assistant put three scenes in one generation in the old build?
whys.because: The old tool list has no planner and no join tool. A single text-to-video call is the obvious path, and nothing told the assistant that one ltx-2.5 clip cannot do timed hard cuts. The new build has plan_video_production, which splits the beats into separate clips, plus join_production_clips.
whys.evidence: tools-old.json starts with get_workflow_guide and upload_chatgpt_image and has no plan or join tool. s5.new.dumper.I46c/calls.jsonl lines 2-3: plan_video_production returns 3 clips of 3 s each and the join step [1,2,3].

whys.why: Why did the new chat still fail, when it did make a separate Saturn clip?
whys.because: The new build did make clip 3, and it joined all three into a 9.1 s film. But the joined film URL is http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/…mp4 and the harness got a 404 when it tried to download it. So the grader got only the separate wait_for_video_project assets. It graded 'about 9 s' as '3 s', ran black-frame checks only on 01 and 02, and described only the Earth and Jupiter frames.
whys.evidence: s5.new.dumper.I46c/calls.jsonl line 6: clip 3 is created (cmwbi2fe604ufka010mxcosm4). Line 9: it completes, with asset 03. Line 10: join returns 9.1 s, but files says 'download failed: download 404 http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/…'. grade.json: 'about 9 s' got '3 s'; black-frame checks only for 01 and 02.

whys.why: Why can one ltx-2.5 generation not make three timed scenes?
whys.because: A single text-to-video generation makes one continuous shot. It does not obey per-second scene timing or hard cuts, so later subjects morph into earlier ones. This is a property of the generation model.
whys.evidence: Old grade: 'Transitions are blended', 'Jupiter … has rings drawn on it and there is a second ring-bearing planet'. The new plan's advice also warns that chained clips keep the earlier place ('last-frame-keeps-place'), which shows the same continuity bias in the model.

result.axiom: ltx-2.5 (the free-plan video model) makes one continuous shot for each generation. It cannot do timed hard cuts between three different planets in a single 9 s clip, so 'Saturn' becomes a ringed Jupiter. In the new build the split-clip approach would avoid this, but a harness defect hid the Saturn clip: the joined film on 127.0.0.1 gave a 404, and the grader saw only clips 1-2.
result.fix: Old build: when a request names several timed scenes, steer the assistant to make one clip per scene and join them. For example, add a line to the create_video_from_text description: 'one call = one continuous shot; for multiple scenes, generate each separately and join'. Better, ship the new plan_video_production/join_production_clips tools. Harness, for the new build: make the joined film URL downloadable (serve it at a host the grader can reach, or copy the local file into assets) so the grader judges the 9 s film. At minimum, make sure all three clip assets go to the judge.
